oddities: gray vs slate mix: PatchNotePreview uses text-slate-500/700/400 and border-slate-200 alongside text-gray-700/400/900 in the same component; the other three files are gray-only.
Off-brand hex: hover:bg-[#003E7E] is used as the hover for bg-[#153974] add buttons (list and card view) — not one of #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA.

Brand primary split: CourseCatalog uses #153974 for active chips/toggles/add buttons but #3069B3 for its spinner; AllPlansModal uses #3069B3 for card hover border, outline button, spinner, and the gradient end stop. No single 'primary' token.
#00AACA (brand cyan) appears only once in these files — curriculum year badge bg-[#00AACA]/10 text-[#00AACA]; cyan-on-white text at 10px is low contrast (~2.6:1).
Ad-hoc alpha steps on brand hex: bg-[#153974]/5, /10, /20, text-[#153974]/60, border-[#153974]/20, bg-[#00AACA]/10, bg-purple-50/30 (effectively white).
Two spinner implementations: CSS ring div (animate-spin rounded-full h-8 w-8 border-b-2 border-[#3069B3]) in CourseCatalog vs lucide Loader2 in both modals.
Three loading strings: '로딩...' (count), '...' (buttons), '로딩 중...' (load-more), plus '계획을 불러오는 중...'.

Category color system defined three times in CourseCatalog with different scales: list badge (-100 bg/-700 text, 2-char labels '전핵/전필/…'), filter chip (-500 active, -50/-600 inactive, full labels '전공핵심/…'), quick-add cards (-500/-600/-200/-700/-50). free_elective badge text is -600 while every other badge is -700. `labels` and `chipColors` objects are recreated inside the .map() render callback.

Hue collisions: orange = major_elective (badge/chip) AND minor (부전공 chip + '부전' badge); purple (복수전공) vs violet (교직) are near-identical hues side by side; blue-100/blue-700 = general_required badge AND the PatchNotePreview version pill.
Emerald carries three unrelated meanings: custom-course badge (text-emerald-600 / bg-emerald-500 ribbon), the '+ 추가' header button (bg-emerald-500), and semester filter chips (bg-emerald-500 active).
Add '+' buttons differ between views: list w-5 h-5 text-xs no transition; card w-6 h-6 text-sm transition-colors shadow-sm z-10 absolute top-2 right-2; card shows '...' when adding, list keeps '+'.
Corner 'ribbon' badges with asymmetric radii (rounded-br-md rounded-tl-md / rounded-bl-md rounded-tr-md) appear only in CourseCatalog card view.

Bare `border`, `border-b`, `border-t` without a color class on the view-toggle wrapper, quick-add cards (color supplied via ${cat.borderColor} there), and both modal headers/footers — in Tailwind v4 the default border color is currentColor, so these resolve to the inherited text color rather than gray-200 unless globals.css overrides it.
Border widths inconsistent: 1px (catalog panel, quick-add cards, preview cards) vs 2px (plan cards, load-more button, group header border-b-2, dashed preview frame, spinner border-b-2).

Radius scale mixed in one surface: catalog panel rounded-lg, modals rounded-xl, chips rounded-full, micro badges rounded (4px), group header rounded-t-md, buttons rounded-md and rounded-lg, dropdown mock rounded-lg.
Shadow scale used: shadow-sm (panel, card add button), shadow-md (plan card hover), shadow-2xl (modal panel). Modal overlay is bg-black/50 with no blur.

One-off arbitrary sizes: text-[10px], text-[11px]; max-h-[350px], sm:max-h-[400px], max-h-[320px], max-h-[85vh]; w-7 label width; calc widths sm:w-[calc(50%-6px)] md:w-[calc(33.333%-8px)] lg:w-[calc(25%-9px)] xl:w-[calc(20%-9.6px)] that hard-code gap-3 = 12px arithmetic (fragile; CSS grid would be simpler).

Contrast concerns: text-gray-300 help icon on white (~1.5:1); text-gray-400 on white used for subtitles, footnotes, filter labels at text-xs/[11px] (~2.5:1, fails AA); text-[#153974]/60 at 10px; white text on bg-emerald-500 / bg-green-500 / bg-orange-500 chips at text-xs (~2.5–3.1:1, fails AA normal text); disabled quick-add bg-gray-200 text-gray-400 (~1.6:1); placeholder text-gray-400 italic.

Accessibility: view-toggle and filter chip buttons do not expose aria-pressed/selected state; draggable list rows attach dnd listeners to the wrapper while a nested <button> relies on stopPropagation; modals set role=dialog/aria-modal/aria-label and focus the panel but have no focus trap and no aria-labelledby tie to the h2; modals manage document.body.style.overflow manually with a nested z-40/z-50 pair; collapse chevron svg has no aria-hidden (button has aria-label, so acceptable).
AnonymousPlanModal error state is styled amber (text-amber-600, AlertCircle) with reassuring copy and auto-closes in 2s; CourseCatalog error is plain text-red-500 — two different error idioms.
AnonymousPlanModal header/panel/footer markup and the privacy sentence are duplicated verbatim from AllPlansModal rather than shared.
PatchNotePreview contains SYNC comments pointing to layout.tsx lines 278-303 — notification item styling is maintained by hand in two places.
Copy inconsistency: '수강계획' (unspaced) in headings vs '수강 계획' (spaced) in the AllPlansModal empty state.
AnonymousPlanModal semester sort uses a one-arg comparator `.sort((a) => (a.term === 'spring' ? -1 : 1))` — likely a logic bug (not a design issue).
